request: Design a machined aluminium L-bracket to mount a 2 kg sensor box to a flat plate with four M6 bolts.

M01.question: How is the sensor box attached to the bracket leg that carries it (fastener type, size, number and hole positions), and where is the sensor box's centre of mass relative to its mounting face?
M01.answer: The sensor box is attached with two M5 bolts, 40 mm apart horizontally. The centre of mass is 40 mm from the mounting face

M06.question: Your answer gives the horizontal spacing of the two M5 bolts. At what height above the flat plate should the two M5 holes be, or, if you do not have that figure, how far does the sensor box extend below its two M5 holes?
M06.answer: The two M5 holes are 35 mm above the flat plate.

analysis.summary: Machined aluminium L-bracket holding a 2 kg sensor box on a flat plate with four M6 bolts. The user answer M01 fixes the sensor-box fasteners (two M5 bolts, 40 mm apart horizontally) and its centre-of-mass offset (40 mm). The vertical position of the M5 holes on the carrying leg was asked for but not given; the follow-up answer M06 places them 35 mm above the flat plate.

assumptions.text: Concept-level design: nominal geometry, no tolerancing, no FEA or fatigue analysis; sizing by one hand calculation only.
assumptions.impact: Results are not a structural sign-off.

assumptions.text: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION (not stated by the user): aluminium 6061-T6 (material id AL6061-T6).
assumptions.rationale: Common general-purpose machining alloy; the request says only 'aluminium'.
assumptions.impact: Handbook yield strength (NOT_VERIFIED) used in the bending check.

assumptions.text: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION (not stated by the user): design load = 5 x the static weight of the 2 kg box, required safety factor on yield 2.0.
assumptions.rationale: No environment given; covers handling, shock and vibration at concept level.
assumptions.impact: Drives plate thickness; must be confirmed for the real environment.

assumptions.text: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION (not stated by the user): no hard envelope limit; keep the bracket compact.
assumptions.impact: Leg lengths and width follow from hole layout and edge-distance rules.

assumptions.impact: The bracket defines the plate drilling pattern.

steps: Fix the interfaces from the user's words: base leg 4 x M6 to the plate (R03); carrying leg 2 x M5, 40 mm apart horizontally (R06), hole centres 35 mm above the plate (R08).
Size clearance holes per STD-ISO273-MEDIUM: M6 -> 6.6 mm, M5 -> 5.5 mm.
Choose width, leg lengths and base-hole layout so every hole centre is >= 1.5 d from free edges (GL-HOLE-EDGE-DISTANCE) and clear of the bend.
Choose thickness from the bending hand calculation with the user's lever arm (R07) and the assumed design load (A03, A02); respect min wall (DFM-MACH-WALL-MIN).
Internal bend radius per DFM-MACH-INNER-RADIUS-MIN and DFM-DFMEA-FATIGUE-FILLET.
Build the parametric model in Fusion; inspect read-only; validate; review.

bracket_thickness.rationale: Engineering decision: hand calc with the assumed load gives a large margin already at 4 mm; 5 mm chosen for bolt-clamping stiffness.

bend_inner_radius.rationale: >= 3 mm end-mill rule and >= 0.2 t fatigue rule.

bracket_width.rationale: User M5 spacing 40 mm (R06) + 2 x 1.5 x 5.5 mm edge distance = 56.5 mm minimum -> 60 mm.

leg_base_length.rationale: Last base hole row at 52 mm + 1.5 x 6.6 mm = 61.9 mm minimum -> 64 mm.

leg_upright_height.rationale: User hole height 35 mm (R08) + 1.5 x 5.5 mm = 43.25 mm minimum -> 50 mm.

base_hole_diameter.rationale: ISO 273 medium clearance for the user's M6 bolts.

base_hole_x0.rationale: Engineering decision: socket access next to the carrying leg (A06).

base_hole_pitch_x.rationale: Engineering decision: spread the four M6 bolts along the base to resist the overturning moment; plate drilled to suit (A05).

base_hole_pitch_y.rationale: Side edge distance (30 - 18) = 12 mm = 1.82 d >= 1.5 d.

upright_hole_diameter.rationale: ISO 273 medium clearance for the user's M5 bolts.

upright_hole_z0.rationale: User: hole centres 35 mm above the flat plate (R08 interpretation of M06).

upright_hole_pitch_z.rationale: Single row of holes (R06) - not used.

upright_hole_pitch_y.rationale: User: M5 bolts 40 mm apart horizontally.

upright_hole_rows.rationale: Two bolts side by side horizontally (R06 interpretation).

load_case.description: Box weight 2 kg (R02) x assumed factor 5 (A03) = 98.1 N acting at the user's centre-of-mass offset of 40 mm (R07) from the carrying-leg face: constant bending moment on that leg.

new_assumptions.text: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION (not stated by the user): M6 hex-head bolts with washers installed from above with a socket; >= 15 mm from hole centre to the inner face of the carrying leg.
new_assumptions.rationale: Tool access for the base bolts next to the carrying leg.

verification_plan: Pre-CAD (Python): manufacturing rules and the bending hand calculation.
Fusion (read-only): body count, feature health, sketches constrained, bbox, volume vs analytic model, parameters vs record.
Own hole geometry: all 4 M6 and 2 M5 holes at designed position, axis and diameter. Mating fit with plate and sensor box will remain NOT_VERIFIED (parts not modelled).

reviews.rationale: No blocking failures. Fusion measurements match the design: 1 solid body, 8/8 healthy features, 3/3 fully constrained sketches, bbox 64 x 60 x 50 mm, volume equal to the analytic model, 14/14 parameters, and the bracket's own 6 holes at designed position/axis/diameter - including the user-specified M5 pair 40 mm apart with centres 35 mm above the plate face (HOLE_GEOMETRY_VERIFIED). Accepted at concept level only: fit with the plate and sensor box is MATING_INTERFACE_NOT_VERIFIED (parts not modelled); the bending check is STRUCTURAL_CHECK_ASSUMPTION (assumed load factor A03, handbook material A02) and overall STRUCTURAL_ADEQUACY_NOT_VERIFIED; manufacturing rules pass as ASSUMPTION because their transcriptions are not human-verified. Screenshot reviewed. Note: the hole-height figure was interpreted as hole-centre height (R08).
